purpose: Follow-up on broad exact-name sweep entries for the non-European/Seki family, separating Seki direct Kokusho work-in-progress from al-Battani work-level evidence and preventing intermediate checkpoints from being promoted as complete editions.

decisions.decision: Most exact-name misses are intermediate Seki/Kokusho checkpoints around p001-p018. The public README/current-status already point to the later `Seki_Direct_Kokusho_p008_018_SecondHeikeiThroughShin_SourceIncluded_WorkCheckpoint_20260608.zip` as the current large pending checkpoint. Earlier p008-p018 ThroughBitsu/Zui and p001-p009 packages are useful lineage/source witnesses but superseded as public status. Do not call p008-p018 complete: internal TODOs keep p008 promotion, p009 diagrams, and p010 readings/diagrams open.

The recovered al-Battani file-evidence package is substantive and consistent with current public status: complete trilingual text over 100 segments; complete fixed-star catalogue and geography data layers; chronology framework/canon partial; zodiac auxiliary tables documented as not cleanly present in Nallino's Latin table source. Keep legacy 'complete critical' filenames disclaimed as non-certification.

representative_inspections.inspection: Contains latest clean p001-p009 work package plus older lineage, full Seki/Kokusho and Takebe/Tohoku source witnesses, audits, renders, and compile checks. Internal Codex audit says it is usable as a continuation package but not certified as direct Kokusho/Seki through p009 because authority witness split must be reconciled: latest package authority was Takebe/Tohoku with partial Kokusho collation.

Large source-included checkpoint with crop witnesses and page/column ledgers through a p018 stage. Internal active TODO says hand reading against Kokusho with Takebe collation remains the authority; OCR is non-authoritative; p008, p009 diagrams, p010 readings/diagrams, and later reconciliations remain open. This is superseded by later ThroughShin package for public pointer purposes.

Contains final_outputs including al_battani_opus_astronomicum_COMPLETE.pdf, catalogue/geography/chronology outputs, completeness statement, lessons learned, segment source recovery tree, round83 canonical reference, table structured data, source manifests, and prior web/pro artifacts. Completeness statement says text complete, fixed-star catalogue/geography complete, chronology partial, zodiac not cleanly present in Nallino's Latin volume.

public_facing_caveats_to_keep: Seki/Japanese direct Kokusho work is active work-in-progress, not a complete Japanese mathematics edition.
Older Seki p008 partial/checkpoint ZIPs are lineage and source witnesses; latest public pointer should remain the ThroughShin checkpoint until a compact reader rollup exists.
OCR/VLM/Pix2Text output in Seki is locator support only; hand reading against Kokusho with Takebe collation controls readings.
al-Battani has a coherent work-level reader/data surface, but not every auxiliary table is complete; keep table-scope caveats visible.
next_actions: No new loose upload is implied by this slice.
If publishing Seki, make a compact reader/status rollup rather than uploading many multi-GB intermediate checkpoints.
If refreshing al-Battani, front the work-level PDF/data surfaces and keep the completeness statement with table block caveats.
